bundle.shortDescription: Consent-first email on the mailbox you already have
bundle.longDescription: ohmail is consent-first email on the mailboxes you already have. It connects to your own IMAP mail server over TLS, mirrors your mailbox to a database on this computer, and organises new mail into ohmail/ folders on the server itself, where every other mail app you own can see it. First-time senders wait in the Screener until you say where they belong. The app carries its own mail engine and its own Node runtime. Besides your mail server and the signed update check, it fetches the pictures in a message you open (a switch makes each message ask first), sends the one-click unsubscribe a screen-out asks for where the list offers one (a switch turns it off), looks up through your system's DNS resolver the key a company or a newsletter signs its mail with, where your provider does not confirm senders itself, and, only if you turn it on, sends requests to the model provider you chose.
